dependencyPolicy.description: Module ownership, allowed/required V3 module edges and forbidden artifact classes for the AWS SDK for Java V3.

artifactClass.description: AWS SDK for Java V2 artifacts and Smithy Java bridges that pull them in.
Code-generation artifacts (Smithy build/codegen toolchains and the V3 generator).

Full Smithy model parser/assembler artifacts and everything built on the semantic model, including the optional V3 dynamic layer (dynamic-model and dynamic-client), which parses runtime models (Requirements 14.18, 15.5).
Per-service generated protocol marshaller artifacts (V3 protocols are schema-driven).
Concrete HTTP implementations and engines (opt-in only, Requirement 15.7).
V3 migration, release-evidence and test modules, which must stay out of production trees.
Smithy Java runtime modules. Parser, codegen, bridge and exporter modules are excluded by the forbidden classes above, which always win.
Smithy model and codegen toolchains, allowed only for build-time generation and the optional dynamic model.
Reactive Streams API, retained for asynchronous streaming parity.

concern.description: Public API: stability annotations, base exceptions, builders, request overrides and AWS client contracts.
Schema SERDE: Smithy Java Schema, SerializableStruct, Document and codecs, plus the runtime version handshake.
Protocol runtime: protocol selection, HTTP bindings and schema-driven protocol implementations.
AWS pipeline: call engine, pipeline plans, stages, interceptor/plugin dispatch, cancellation and timeouts.
Telemetry contract; exporters are separate opt-in artifacts.
HTTP SPI: immutable HTTP messages, sync/async SPIs, streaming and cancellation.
Optional dynamic model layer and dynamic client.
The single AWS code generator and its Maven lifecycle wrapper.
Generated service clients, models, descriptors and registries.
Parity manifest, release gates, evidence and architecture tests.

waiver.description: Every published Smithy Java core release declares a compile dependency on smithy-model, whose single jar holds both the ShapeId/ShapeType/Trait/Node classes that Schema exposes and the IDL/JSON AST parser and ModelAssembler. The artifact cannot be excluded until Smithy Java publishes a separate shape-identity/runtime-trait artifact. This is an open deviation from Requirement 15.5 at the artifact level; remove the waiver once that artifact exists.
waiver.enforcement: Class-level: smithy-runtime's SmithyRuntimeBoundary lists the forbidden parser/assembler/codegen classes and SmithyRuntimeClassLoadingTest proves generated-style clients resolve none of them. No module other than smithy-runtime may declare smithy-model.

serviceTemplate.owns: Generated types, clients, operation descriptors, registry and small service-specific plugin descriptors.

module.owns: Public stability and thread-safety annotations.

Base exceptions, request/response metadata, builders, typed configuration keys, request overrides, close aggregation, sync/async body transformers, and the pagination (SdkIterable, SdkPublisher, page publisher) and waiter (acceptors, Smithy backoff, sync and non-blocking async poll loops) runtimes.
Curated re-export and compatibility boundary for Smithy Java Schema, SerializableStruct, Document, codecs and protocol interfaces; runtime version handshake.
AwsClient, AwsClientConfiguration, region/partition/configuration providers, identity APIs and AWS metadata.
AwsCallEngine, PipelinePlan, stages, context, interceptor/plugin dispatch, cancellation, timeout and exception mapping.
Auth scheme and signer APIs.
AWS auth schemes and signers (SigV4, SigV4a, bearer).
Identity types and identity-provider SPI.
Default AWS identity providers and provider chains.
Regions, partitions and region providers.
Endpoint resolution and endpoint-rules runtime.
Retry strategies and retry-token buckets.
Checksum algorithms and request/response integrity, request compression and content-encoding feature plugins.
Event stream framing and codecs.
Protocol selection and HTTP binding contracts, shared SERDE helpers (including event stream SERDE over the eventstream framing), and the shared XML reader/writer of the XML protocols.
Schema-driven awsJson1_0/awsJson1_1 protocol.
Schema-driven restJson1 protocol.

Schema-driven awsQuery protocol.

V3 dynamic facade and dynamic operation descriptors.
Smithy JSON AST parser/model assembler, model-to-schema conversion and dynamic operation descriptors.
The only AWS Smithy DirectedCodegen implementation.
Maven lifecycle integration for aws-codegen; no emitters of its own.
DynamoDB Enhanced synchronous and asynchronous clients.
S3 Transfer Manager.
IAM policy builder.
S3 event notification models, schemas, primary type registry and JSON reading and writing.
SNS message parsing and signature verification.

OpenRewrite-style V2-to-V3 recipes, diagnostics and the migration manifest reader: the migration engine and its recipe extension point, the Parity Manifest reader, the machine-readable migration report, and the Maven plugin that runs them. It reads V2 source and POMs but never links V2 or V3 runtime code.
Launch parity manifest and its validation.
The generated service fleet plan (V2 baseline to canonical models), its writer and the fleet gate.
Release gates and release evidence, including the machine-readable V2 compatibility report.
Architecture tests that enforce this policy, the BOM and runtime version alignment.

Bounded-memory streaming and Reactive Streams release suites: the TCK of the public AsyncRequestBody factories, AsyncResponseTransformer subscribers and generated async paginator publishers not verified in their own modules, and a 1 GiB payload streamed upload and download, sync and async, through generated clients, the real pipeline and real transports over loopback HTTP in a 256 MiB heap. Every dependency is test scope.

Compile and compatibility fixtures of generated synthetic, DynamoDB and S3 APIs, and execution of the Parity Manifest's generated compatibility fixtures: preserved V2 surfaces compile, link and keep their signatures and hierarchy, adapted and excluded calls are rejected with manifest-linked diagnostics, and V2 caller bytecode runs against V3.
Fixture service module proving aws-codegen-maven-plugin generates sources before compilation and that generated operation descriptors and clients compile against the V3 runtime.
Black-box aws-codegen tests: byte-identical generated trees and integration conflict diagnostics.

Barrier-controlled release concurrency suites of generated sync/async clients, identity resolvers, interceptors, retries, paginators, waiters and high-level libraries, and the dependency-free harness (src/main) they and the HTTP transport suite share. Every other dependency is test scope.

The generated-versus-dynamic differential release matrix: every launch protocol, call shape and sync/async mode through generated synthetic and fleet service clients and the Dynamic Client built from the same model AST, compared on the wire and on modeled results.

Fleet schema fidelity (every generated schema of every fleet service against its canonical Smithy shape) and the V3-versus-canonical-versus-V2 wire differential per protocol and binding category, whose intentional deltas name ADAPTED or EXCLUDED Parity Manifest entries. Every dependency is test scope; the released V2 jars are loaded from target/v2-baseline in an isolated class loader, never from the class path.

The deterministic pipeline fault-injection kit (src/main: a generatable fault trace, controllable transport, identity, signer, endpoint, scheduler and body fakes, recorders and a harness over the client build state) and the release fault matrix through the real pipeline and generated sync/async clients. The generated services are test scope.
HTTP SPI TCK: capability-driven sync and async conformance suites run against every HTTP implementation and mode.
Cross-protocol property tests of the launch protocol runtimes: Schema SERDE round trips over random schemas.

Smithy protocol conformance: every applicable case of the pinned smithy-aws-protocol-tests and smithy-protocol-tests models through clients generated by aws-codegen, the seven launch protocol runtimes and the real pipeline over a capturing transport, with a checked-in approved-omission list. Every dependency is test scope.

Endpoint conformance: every smithy.rules#endpointTests case of every vendored fleet model (services/service-fleet.json) through the V3 endpoint rule evaluator, with a checked-in approved-omission list. Every dependency is test scope.
Clean-checkout release reactor and aggregate-profile inventory tests.

The V2 Migration Corpus: representative and synthetic V2 applications migrated with the real Parity Manifest, their compile and behavioral suites on the V2 baseline and on the candidate, and the compatibility report they publish. Every dependency is test scope.
Performance harness and benchmarks, including the generated DynamoDB benchmark fixture.
